title: West Market Street on the approach to Monument Circle
summary: A dated Indianapolis photograph exposed an unrelated restaurant sign repeated on the prior building texture. The street is in a national map tile. Its named retail places are now associated with individual building outlines, and the repeated donor business lettering is gone.
measurement: The two game views use the same camera and lighting. Restoring the original frontage produced an identical control frame, and four wheels stayed in contact. Two of 50 footprints in this tile meet the retail evidence check. The Oliver P. Morton statue, distant monument and the buildings’ specific façades remain visibly different from the photograph.
